The Jul 11 split (84460c9cd + parity tests 1630a540e) left every consumer importing the root monolith, so framework/world_loader/ edits compiled silently into nothing — my req_3028 sticker fix AND d6880d1ba's live_inputs change were both dead on arrival. Cut over all four import sites (v8_app.zig, v8_bindings_compiled_world.zig, engine.zig, gpu/world_window.zig) to the framework/world_loader.zig facade, retargeted rjit game's LOADER_SOURCE, dropped the deleted root from the dev-build fingerprint list, rebundled tools/rjit.js, and DELETED world_loader.zig (git history keeps the comparator; README records the retirement + baseline sha). Verification chain: test-world-loader parity green, full editor ship compiles against the facade, binary string-probe shows sticker_quad(2)+grass-blade(1), and rjit shot editor boots and renders the world headless PASS — the flat sticker quad is visibly live in the shot. One dev-host restart picks all of this up.
